title: Dark's Weapon Control
description: This plugin allows you to change the features of the selected weapons
body:
![DARK'S WEAPON CONTROL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb94671c9923da5d00bde1eb75408f16c5307d3d.png)

- **This plugin is perfect for PvP SMPs. It essentially adds a few features to what weapons can and cannot do, which are as follows:**
### 1. Cooldown
 - Cooldown makes it so that when you use the weapon you will not be able to use it for a selected amount of time
### 2. Damage
 - Damage changes the amount of damage that weapon does
### 3.Enchant
 - You can enable and disable selected enchants and levels

## Commands
- /mace 
- /spear
- /sword
- /axe
- /trident
- /crossbow
- /bow
